name: strengthapp-store
description: Strength Tracker - gestion de entrenamientos de gimnasio (web + Android via Capacitor). Offline-first.

scripts.build:check: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const html=fs.readFileSync('www/index.html','utf8'); const script=html.match(/<script>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/); if(!script){console.error('Inline application bundle not found');process.exit(1);} console.log('Bundle OK:',script[1].length,'chars');"
scripts.prebuild:android: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run sync
scripts.verify: npm run build:check && npm run lint && npm run test

author: Jorge
